Method of Attack: Displaying out of context (OOC) ads that appear to come from legitimate apps on the phone
Using modified legitimate Android and Unity SDK packages to deliver OOC ads
Using Tencent Legu packer to obfuscate and evade detection
Tracking screen state to deliver ads at optimal times for valid impressions
Responding to multiple system triggers (system boot, connection changes, charging cable plug in/out, app installations) to maintain persistence
Command and control (C2) server instructing ad display via hacked domain
Impacted Systems: Android devices with Google Play Store
Attack Vector: Malicious apps distributed via Google Play Store
Indicators of Compromise: Modified Android and Unity SDK packages containing OOC ad code
